study.question: Does a task-specific linear map of each task rank summary minus the across-task mean add utility to R12, beyond the same per-task maps supplied only the mean, while retaining the stronger memory-joint source and the frozen training protocol?
study.hypothesis: Observation: R12 private-linear scores 0.8310755947860231 macro AUC versus g0 0.8303789178781177 and g3 source 0.8294837888998853. R12 private-copy scores 0.8306211408644399; mean-linear 0.830471497201018 and mean-copy 0.8303725090131304. The linear-vs-copy difference is +0.0004544539215832 with private routing versus +0.0000989881878876 with mean routing, a single-seed interaction estimate +0.0003554657336956, not replicated mechanism evidence. R12-minus-g0 task AUC changes are click -0.0000803863458994, cart +0.0013664593678040, fav +0.0014729427568423, buy +0.0000276918528747. The pooled gain does not mean every task improved. Inspected limitation: _task_pool forms distinct M_t but applies one shared 112-by-112 task_extra_projection P before separate nonlinear towers. The shared P restricts direct linear transforms of task rank evidence; the towers can already emulate some task specificity, so harmful sharing is only a hypothesis. Provisional mechanism: retaining P(M_t), add a zero-start head-specific map Q_t(M_t - mean_s M_s) to preserve relative task rank content at the final readout without feeding it back into shared tokens. An active common-source control Q_t(mean_s M_s) tests whether added task-specific matrix capacity alone suffices. Lineage review constrains this choice: R13 contextual scoring (memory-private 0.8309696093096159; static-private 0.8309294998382515; mean counterparts 0.8303638539316801/0.8304330439477664) did not beat R12; R14 input-gradient blocking (click 0.8308403372592208, auxiliary 0.8305847950391266, both 0.8305824963765673) did not beat open 0.8310755947860231. R14-open repeats the identical seed/result and is a replay, not independent replication. R15 private trunks64 0.8309133862899759 and shared trunk210 0.8309514201872332 added about 77k parameters without beating R12. R16 private summary exchange 0.8300677128487329 and mean exchange 0.830158082387002 both lost to R12 and g0; the private-minus-mean effect is -0.0000903695382691. This opposes that early-exchange implementation, not all task conditioning. No failed execution appears among the 19 supplied trajectories; scientifically unsuccessful successful executions are retained as negative evidence. Historical candidate_diagnostics are not_requested, not proof of passed numeric gates. This is a local extension of inherited components, with no priority claim or established gradient-interference mechanism.

study.proposed_difference: For existing FP32 extra summaries M in [B,4,112], compute mean Mbar over the task axis and D_t=M_t-Mbar in every arm. Append task_rank_bank with shape [4,112,112], initialized to zero after all inherited initialization; no bias or random draws. Each task readout remains C_t+P(M_t), augmented by D_t @ Q_t in candidate task_rank_contrast, or Mbar @ Q_t in control task_rank_common. The original shared DIN sum is still added in forward. Both sources are materialized contiguous and the same FP32 einsum btv,tvw->btw is executed. All source values derive only from the existing visible histories and relevance scorers. The task mean uses all four prediction-task summaries, not current labels. No new training-loss hook, attention, shared-memory update, external input or data pass is introduced. Both arms keep task_routing private; the control changes only the source of the new maps, never the inherited M_t or C_t. Zero banks are an initialization replay, not an inactive experimental arm. The common control can learn distinct Q_t and remains active whenever Mbar is nonzero. Expected new parameters per arm 4*112*112=50176, total33119433, embedding31793216, dense1326217; host counts authoritative.
predictions: Primary directional prediction: task_rank_contrast exceeds both R12 macro AUC 0.8310755947860231 and task_rank_common at the same seed and full frozen protocol. Exceeding only g0/g3 source bests is insufficient for incremental mechanism support. Select on validation four-task macro AUC with declared Logloss/parameters/trial-ID ties; never use click alone or introduce a per-task veto.

If task-specific rank deviations add information, the contrast arm will improve the relative rare-task readout compared with common source; report all four AUC/Logloss deltas even if the macro gain masks a regression. Buy gains are a predeclared diagnostic direction, not a selection rule.

At paired construction, all inherited parameters/buffers and CPU RNG states should match R12. With zero Q both arms should replay R12 initial predictions, inherited gradients and Dice-buffer updates. At initialization all scorer outputs and M are zero, so Q gradients are expected zero until scorers open.

With diagnostic nonzero Q and nondegenerate M: isolated contrast update is invariant to adding one common vector to every M_t, while isolated common update changes; isolated common update is invariant to zero-task-mean perturbations, while the contrast update can change. Apply these tests to the helper only because inherited P(M_t) changes in both full models. Empty-history rank residual is exactly zero for any finite Q.

Parameter counts and nominal forward operators are equal across the new arms. Additional contraction is 4*112*112 MACs/example (411041792 at batch8192); report measured training/full wall and inference latency/throughput/peak GPU memory rather than infer equal compute from parameter equality.
falsifiers: Failure to beat R12, or a tie/loss to the active common-source control, opposes incremental task-contrast utility for this implementation. If both additions win equally, evidence favors added maps/optimization capacity rather than task-contrast information. A control win opposes the directional hypothesis and remains eligible under the same selection rule.

Loss of an apparent improvement under a genuinely different paired seed weakens repeated support; an identical-seed replay is not independent evidence. No significance claim from these single-seed validation comparisons.

Any changed inherited initialization, label-dependent forward path, invalid output shape/nonfinite gradients, masked-ID/current-action dependence, inactive common control on a nondegenerate diagnostic, or nonzero empty-history residual invalidates the implementation before scientific scoring.

If measured cost makes the selected arm dominated by R12 on quality and compute, no efficiency benefit is established even with a small quality gain. The common/contrast source contrast alone cannot establish shared-gradient conflict.
alternative_explanations: Added functional capacity or redundant parameterization with shared P, rather than unique rank evidence; active common-source replacement and historical R15 capacity failures reduce but do not eliminate this explanation.

Contrast and mean differ in signal variance, correlation, gradient coupling and BF16 rounding. They are equal-parameter/operator replacements, not identical functional families or equal effective backward cost. No variance-normalized control is claimed within this budget.

The existing nonlinear towers can already apply task-specific transforms. A null result may mean the extra linear maps are redundant or learn too slowly because rank summaries and zero-start output projections open late during the single pass; it does not refute all task-specific temporal representations.

Validation adaptation across many trials, rare-task label counts and seed-dependent optimization can explain small gains. Three paired seeds and unseen-data confirmation are not guaranteed; held-out data are unavailable and must never enter this phase.

Inherited official_offline histories and static snapshots have unestablished production point-in-time validity; cart/fav/buy labels concern user/category/brand within24h rather than advertisement-attributed conversion. Relative rank is not elapsed time.

Raw parquet files/digests, sample predictions and user grouping are not exposed here. The pinned host protocol and receipts are the reproducibility boundary; do not invent a local dataset audit, user bootstrap or new slices.
